t: A budget Linux board shaped like a Raspberry Pi 3 with 4K video.
steps: Buy the board from a reseller such as LoverPi or Newegg. Prices vary a lot.
Get a 5 volt 2 amp micro-USB supply, a microSD card and an HDMI cable.
Download a Debian, Ubuntu or Raspbian image from the Libre Computer hub.
Write the image to the card with a free image writing app.
Boot the board and connect it to your router with a network cable.
Install Blinka and run a Python example that blinks an LED on the header.
Use the libretech-wiring-tool to turn on extra header features next.
meta: Open Board. From $60. A few stores.
